title: DocIntel — AI Document Intelligence
descHtml: Upload any document and get AI classification, summarisation, and citation-backed Q&A through a production RAG pipeline: FastEmbed (ONNX) embeddings + Chroma vector search, with a multi-provider LLM abstraction (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic) and automatic fallback. Sub-second retrieval across 1000+ chunks; embedding footprint cut from ~4GB to ~400MB; 95%+ uptime on a 16GB free tier.

title: Predictive Maintenance Platform
descHtml: Detects industrial equipment faults before they cause downtime, using a Random Forest + XGBoost ensemble over sensor data (vibration, temperature, pressure) with wavelet feature engineering and SHAP explainability. 85%+ accuracy, sub-100ms inference, served via FastAPI + a live Streamlit dashboard.

title: Smart AI Assistant
descHtml: An end-to-end RAG-powered conversational assistant with semantic search, bilingual (English/Hindi) support, and auto error detection. A FAISS-indexed pipeline with context-aware generation that reduced repetitive support queries by ~40% in production.

title: Career Compass — Guidance Engine
descHtml: A personalised AI career-guidance platform with a custom RAG pipeline and voice-enabled interaction. FAISS vector retrieval for context-aware responses over a guidance knowledge base, on a scalable FastAPI backend with JWT auth and modular service design.

descHtml: A full-stack ML dashboard with dual prediction models behind a clean FastAPI + SQLModel backend. Compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost & XGBoost with reusable preprocessing pipelines — ~80% churn accuracy across three deployment modes.

title: Walmart Sales Forecasting
descHtml: Time-series demand forecasting for retail planning, with trend and seasonality decomposition. Regression + ARIMA/SARIMA models with temporal feature engineering over historical sales — a foundation for inventory, staffing, and supply-chain optimisation.

descHtml: The backend engineering foundation behind the AI work: a high-volume financial-services platform I built end-to-end — 100K+ monthly transactions, ₹1M+ daily payouts via Axis Bank — and where I first put ML into production for anomaly detection and fraud insight via FastAPI.
